#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get current timestamp for release name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release-$TIMESTAMP"

echo "Creating release archive: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    -czf "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" .

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create release archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Get current timestamp for release name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release-$TIMESTAMP"

echo "Creating release archive: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"

# Create a temporary directory listing excluding node_modules and .git
# Then create tar.gz archive from that list
find . -type f \
    ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
    ! -path "./.git/*" \
    ! -path "./release-*.tar.gz" \
    > /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

# Create tar.gz archive from the file list
tar -czf "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" -T /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

# Clean up temporary file
rm /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create release archive"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
validate_env_vars() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read .env.test and check each key has a value
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f1)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        
        # Check if key exists in current environment and has a non-empty value
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < .env.test
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        return 1
    fi
}

# Run validation
if ! validate_env_vars; then
    echo "Error: Environment variable validation failed"
    exit 1
fi

# Get current timestamp for release name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release-$TIMESTAMP"

echo "Creating release archive: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"

# Create a temporary directory listing excluding node_modules and .git
# Then create tar.gz archive from that list
find . -type f \
    ! -path "./node_modules/*" \
    ! -path "./.git/*" \
    ! -path "./release-*.tar.gz" \
    > /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

# Create tar.gz archive from the file list
tar -czf "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" -T /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

# Clean up temporary file
rm /tmp/deploy-files-list.txt

if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Release archive created successfully: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"
    echo "File size: $(du -h "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" | cut -f1)"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to create release archive"
    exit 1
fi

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

            # Extract variable name (before = sign)
            var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
            # Check if variable is set and not empty
            if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
                missing_vars+=("$var_name")
            fi
        fi

        echo "ERROR: The following environment variables are not set or are empty:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo "Please set these variables before deploying."
        exit 1
    else
        echo "All environment variables from .env.test are properly set."
    fi
else
    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation."
fi

DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Create timestamp for unique release naming
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

        if [[ -n "$line" && ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then

        echo "Please set these variables before deploying."

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

            else
                CONFIG_JSON+=","
            fi
            
            # Simple JSON escaping (quotes and backslashes)
            escaped_value=$(echo "$var_value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
            CONFIG_JSON+="\"$var_name\":\"$escaped_value\""
        fi

    # Send to deployment orchestrator

        -d "$CONFIG_JSON" \

    if [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 200 ] || [ "$RESPONSE" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "Configuration successfully sent to deployment orchestrator."
    else
        echo "WARNING: Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $RESPONSE)."

    fi

    echo "Warning: .env.test file not found. Skipping environment variable validation and config sending."
fi

        fi

        fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping environment variable validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line in .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key (everything before the first =)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no key found
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            return 1
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "Environment variable validation passed"
    return 0
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping configuration sending"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    json_content="{"
    first_entry=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
        
        # Skip if no key found
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first entry
        if [ "$first_entry" = true ]; then
            first_entry=false
        else
            json_content="$json_content,"
        fi
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON (escaping quotes in value)
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json_content="$json_content\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json_content="$json_content}"
    
    # Send JSON to deployment orchestrator
    response=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_content" \
        http://localhost:3003/api/deploy-config)
    
    if [ "$response" -eq 200 ] || [ "$response" -eq 201 ]; then
        echo "Configuration sent successfully to deployment orchestrator"
        return 0
    else
        echo "Error: Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator (HTTP $response)"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Run pre-deployment validation
if ! validate_env_vars; then
    echo "Pre-deployment validation failed"
    exit 1
fi

# Send configuration to orchestrator for audit compliance
if ! send_config_to_orchestrator; then
    echo "Failed to send configuration to deployment orchestrator"
    exit 1
fi

# Get current date for release naming
DATE=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
RELEASE_NAME="release-$DATE"

echo "Creating release archive: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
    --warning=no-file-changed \
    -czf "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" .

EXIT_CODE=$?

if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ] || [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 1 ]; then
    # Exit code 1 often just means warnings, not errors
    if [ -f "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" ]; then
        echo "Release archive created successfully: $RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz"
        echo "File size: $(du -h "$RELEASE_NAME.tar.gz" | cut -f1)"
    else
        echo "Error: Release archive was not created"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "Error creating release archive (exit code: $EXIT_CODE)"
    exit $EXIT_CODE
fi

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation step
validate_environment() {
    echo "Validating environment variables..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping environment validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Read each line from .env.test and check if the corresponding env var is set
    missing_vars=()
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before the = sign)
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        
        # Skip if variable name is empty
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")
        fi
    done < ".env.test"
    
    # Report results
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "✓ All environment variables are properly set"
        return 0
    else
        echo "✗ Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        echo ""
        echo "Please set these environment variables before deployment."
        return 1
    fi
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    echo "Sending configuration to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping configuration send"
        return 0

    first=true
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] || [[ -z "${line// }" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name and value
        var_name="${line%%=*}"
        var_value="${line#*=}"
        
        # Skip if variable name is empty
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_content="$json_content,"
        fi
        
        # Add to JSON (escaping quotes in values)
        escaped_value=$(echo "$var_value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json_content="$json_content\"$var_name\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < ".env.test"
    json_content="$json_content}"

    local env_file=".env.test"

        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping environment variable validation"
        return 0
    fi

        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key (before = sign)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if environment variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Required environment variable '$key' is not set or is empty"
            return 1
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
    return 0
}

# Send configuration to deployment orchestrator
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test exists

        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping configuration sending"
        return 0
    fi

    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    local json_config="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do

        # Extract key and value

        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item

        else

        -d "$json_config" \

    local env_file=".env.test"

    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping config send."
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Convert .env.test to JSON format
    local json_data="{"
    local first_entry=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue

    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists
    if [ ! -f ".env.test" ]; then
        echo "Warning: .env.test file not found, skipping validation"
        return 0

        # Extract key (before = sign)
        key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no key found
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue

        # Get value from current environment

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script to create a release archive
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Function to convert .env.test to JSON format
convert_env_to_json() {
    local env_file="$1"
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        local key=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | xargs)
        local value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 2- | xargs)
        
        # Skip if no key found
        if [ -z "$key" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Add comma if not first item
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json="$json,"
        fi
        
        # Add key-value pair to JSON (escaping quotes)
        value_escaped=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/"/\\"/g')
        json="$json\"$key\":\"$value_escaped\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json="$json}"
    echo "$json"
}

validate_env_vars() {
    echo "Validating environment variables from .env.test..."
    
    # Check if .env.test exists

}

    echo "Sending validated configuration to deployment orchestrator..."

if [ -f ".env.test" ]; then
    echo "Reading .env.test for required environment variables..."
    
    # Track validation status
    validation_passed=true
    env_vars=""
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do

                if [ -z "$value" ]; then
                    echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' has no value in .env.test"
                    validation_passed=false
                else
                    echo "✓ $key has a value"
                    # Build JSON object for sending to orchestrator
                    if [ -n "$env_vars" ]; then

# Pre-deployment validation: Check environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    # Check if .env.test file exists
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping environment validation"
        return 0
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    local missing_vars=0
    
    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        if [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract variable name (before = sign)
        var_name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d '=' -f 1 | tr -d ' ')
        
        # Skip if no variable name
        if [ -z "$var_name" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Check if variable is set and not empty
        if [ -z "${!var_name}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$var_name' is not set or is empty"
            missing_vars=$((missing_vars + 1))
        else
            echo "✓ $var_name is set"

        echo "Error: $missing_vars required environment variable(s) missing"

    return 0
